snippet.title: I'm a solo dev and i made a cyberpunk horror game ! Check the FREE DEMO on steam now.
snippet.description:
I'm a solo developer, and I created a cyberpunk horror game! Welcome to DREADCORE: Locked Unit – a narrative-driven psychological horror experience set in a dystopian future where technology and reality blur in terrifying ways. 🕵️‍♂️🔦

💾 Play the FREE DEMO on Steam NOW! 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459030/DREADCORE__Locked_Unit/

In this video, I showcase my journey as a solo indie dev, developing DREADCORE: Locked Unit – a game inspired by SOMA, Observer, and Silent Hill. Expect atmospheric horror, mind-bending puzzles, and a deep, unsettling story.

🔥 What to Expect in DREADCORE: Locked Unit 🔥
✔️ Cyberpunk horror atmosphere
✔️ Psychological and environmental storytelling
✔️ Puzzle-solving and immersive exploration
✔️ A disturbing mystery waiting to be uncovered

If you're into indie horror games, cyberpunk aesthetics, or immersive storytelling, this is for you! Don't forget to LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for more indie dev updates and behind-the-scenes content.

#IndieDev #SoloDev #HorrorGame #Cyberpunk #IndieGame #GameDevelopment #DREADCORE #PsychologicalHorror #FreeDemo #SteamGames #horrorgames #horrorgaming
